xsf_structure.program_semantics: little-endian Nintendo DS ROM offset/size map

sets.validation_scope: Exact container, compressed-program CRC, zlib stream, tags, dependency closure, and 2SF ROM-map overlay validated. Nintendo DS ARM runtime, driver, sequence, voices, and playback were not executed or validated.
sets.regression_use: Dependency-heavy 2SF control with two libraries and two root-to-library populations; preserves container, effective ROM, and runtime as distinct objects.

sets.dependency_graph: Every root 0000.minincsf through 0075.minincsf declares _lib=Mario Kart DS.ncsflib; the library has no dependency.
sets.transformation: The exact bounded SDAT byte range from the existing Mario Kart DS 2SF effective ROM was placed in one NCSF library; 76 roots contain only a four-byte little-endian sequence index plus tags.
sets.source_boundary: No separately published Mario Kart DS NCSF package was located in the inspected public archive. This is a deterministic derived NCSF control, not an independently sourced set and not a claim that the effective SDAT is the original complete cartridge SDAT.
sets.validation_scope: Exact container, compressed-program CRC, dependency closure, reserved sequence index, SDAT magic/declared size, INFO sequence count, selected SSEQ, PLAYER presence/default, bank and wave-archive references validated. Nintendo DS runtime and playback were not executed.
sets.regression_use: Same-work representation control against Mario Kart DS 2SF with named observables and explicit non-equivalence boundaries.

xsf_structure.reserved_semantics: ordered SR64 ROM and Project64 save-state patch tables

sets.regression_use: Downloaded dependency-heavy USF control whose root objects patch a shared library state; validates exact Ocarina of Time USF acquisition without claiming emulation or playback.

sets.region_provenance: USA is source-derived from the retained library identifier; original commercial ROM identity/version is not asserted.
sets.dependency_graph: Every one of the 16 roots declares _lib=AGB-BPEE-USA.gsflib; the library has no dependency.
sets.validation_scope: Exact container, compressed-program CRC, dependency closure, 12-byte little-endian entry/load/size headers, bounded GBA ROM overlay, root-selected entry, byte provenance, tags, and unknown ranges validated. GBA runtime, driver identity, voices, and playback were not executed or validated.
sets.regression_use: Real dependency-heavy GSF control with one full library and per-track two-byte overlays; effective upload image is not claimed to be the original game ROM.

representation_provenance.source_claim: Pack author extracted the WSG music with a reverse-engineered driver, checked it frame-for-frame against MAME register dumps, and converted it to C352.
representation_provenance.reason: Standard VGM has no native Namco WSG support.
representation_provenance.equivalence_limit: This is not a native WSG command timeline; no WSG-to-C352 event or synthesis equivalence is claimed.
